_llm_provider_options.description: Set LLM_PROVIDER env var to override this field. Options:
_llm_provider_options.ollama: Local dev – requires Ollama running on localhost:11434 (set ENV=dev to auto-select)
_llm_provider_options.gemini: Direct Gemini API – requires GEMINI_API_KEY env var
_llm_provider_options.vertex: Vertex AI via ADC – production default, no API key needed on GCP
_llm_provider_options.mock: Deterministic mock – for tests and offline demos
